title: House Varrow is founded
detail: Aldric Varrow raises the Iron Stag over the hill road.

title: House Corvane is founded
detail: Ysolde Corvane raises the Black Raven at Corvane's Reach.

title: House Ashgrove is founded
detail: Wren of Ashgrove raises the White Oak in the eastern vale.

title: House Dunmere is founded
detail: Hale Dunmere raises the Drowned Bell above the flooded town.

title: House Halloran is founded
detail: Petra Halloran raises the Ember Hound at the forge-camps.

title: House Merrin is founded
detail: Odo Merrin raises the Silver Eel at Merrin's Ford.

title: Ysolde Corvane of Corvane takes the throne
detail: Ysolde Corvane is crowned.

title: House Ashgrove swears fealty to House Varrow
detail: House Ashgrove (White Oak) bends the knee to House Varrow (Iron Stag).

title: House Dunmere swears fealty to House Ashgrove
detail: House Dunmere (Drowned Bell) bends the knee to House Ashgrove (White Oak).

title: House Corvane and House Halloran sign a treaty
detail: The treaty holds for 7 days, until 2026-10-05 (UTC).

title: House Merrin swears fealty to House Varrow
detail: House Merrin (Silver Eel) bends the knee to House Varrow (Iron Stag).

title: House Varrow claims the crown
detail: Aldric Varrow of House Varrow declares a claim against Ysolde Corvane of Corvane. The rebellion opens Wednesday 19:00 UTC.

title: House Varrow rises
detail: The rebellion of House Varrow has begun. The throne may be contested until 20:00 UTC.

title: Ysolde Corvane no longer reigns
detail: Ysolde Corvane fell while holding the crown.

title: Aldric Varrow of Varrow takes the throne
detail: The crown passes from Ysolde Corvane to Aldric Varrow.

title: The rebellion of House Varrow ends
detail: House Varrow prevailed and holds the crown.

title: House Ashgrove and House Halloran sign a treaty
detail: The treaty holds for 5 days, until 2026-10-06 (UTC).

title: House Merrin and House Corvane sign a treaty
detail: The treaty holds for 3 days, until 2026-10-04 (UTC).

title: House Dunmere renounces its oath to House Ashgrove
detail: Hale Dunmere breaks the oath of House Dunmere. The house now bears the oathbreaker mark (x1).

title: House Dunmere swears fealty to House Corvane
detail: House Dunmere (Drowned Bell) bends the knee to House Corvane (Black Raven).

title: House Halloran breaks its treaty with House Corvane
detail: Petra Halloran tears up the treaty before its term. House Halloran now bears the treaty-breaker mark (x1).

title: House Dunmere claims the crown
detail: Hale Dunmere of House Dunmere declares a claim against Aldric Varrow of Varrow. The rebellion opens Saturday 19:00 UTC.

title: House Thornwick is founded
detail: Maud Thornwick raises the Grey Heron at the old mill.

title: The King's Peace
detail: No blood may be spilled within the Crown Market until dawn.
